nodes.name: Agent Runtime.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph system node defining the Agent Runtime bounded context, the lateral infrastructure system that handles memory persistence, context-window assembly, and trade logging via the Wake-Execute-Sleep lifecycle, servicing all other systems through the Memory API.
nodes.languageNotes: Ontology-governed dev_graph node (type: system, SYS-004) with structured frontmatter and a required Relationships section for Neo4j export.

nodes.name: Data Pipeline.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph system node defining the Data Pipeline bounded context (SYS-001), the first stage of the trading pipeline owning L1 data ingestion and L2 analysis to produce deterministic Layer 2 Snapshots consumed by the Trading Engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Frontmatter declares downstream_systems: Trading Engine; originates from CQRS and Event Sourcing knowledge assets.

nodes.name: Evaluation Loop.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph system node defining the Evaluation Loop bounded context (SYS-005), the feedback system that scores trading performance, validates promotion readiness against quantitative thresholds, and manages the system lifecycle state machine.
nodes.languageNotes: Declares upstream Agent Runtime (trade data) and downstream Supervisor Office; closes the feedback loop in the engineering continuum.

nodes.name: Risk Control.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph system node defining the Risk Control bounded context (SYS-003), a separate guardrail-enforcement system that validates every trade for exposure and hard limits before it reaches the broker, ensuring the LLM agent cannot bypass constraints.
nodes.languageNotes: Bidirectional with Trading Engine via the Risk Check API; deliberately external so the agent cannot validate its own trades.

nodes.name: Supervisor Office.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph system node defining the Supervisor Office bounded context (SYS-006), the meta-governance system implementing the Syndicate Squad architecture that handles decision making, treasury management, upgrade evaluation, and team orchestration to govern how the trading system evolves.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest system node (4 capabilities); declares upstream Evaluation Loop and Agent Runtime, downstream Trading Engine.

nodes.name: Trading Engine.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph system node defining the Trading Engine bounded context (SYS-002), the central L3 execution system that converts Layer 2 snapshots into signals, validates them against Risk Control, executes orders through broker APIs, and manages position and stop-loss lifecycles.
nodes.languageNotes: Hub node with 5 upstream/downstream system links; tracks a deprecated capability (Signal Generation CAP-004 superseded by Gold Decision Generation CAP-020).
